description: Re-read a server's GitHub repo right now: latest release or tag, package version, README, description, topics. If the version or listing changed, ManyCP updates the saved listing, marks directories that list an older version as needs_update, and starts update runs where a directory supports it (the official registry gets the new version; pull-request directories get an update PR only when the entry text changed). If nothing changed it says so. Paid plans also sync on their own (Pro every hour, Starter every day), so use this to sync now, for example right after a release. Needs a launched server or a paid plan.

server.description: Which server: its id (srv_...), its slug, its GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/name or owner/name), or its exact name. list_servers shows them all.

name: sync_server
title: Sync a server with GitHub
